item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows Reyansh's two simple pendulums in the lab. Both have the same string length at the same place. Pendulum X has a small clay bob. Pendulum Y has a larger steel bob. He sets both swinging with small oscillations.

Answer both parts.

parts.text: Which claim about their time periods is correct?

options.text: X and Y have the same time period, because time period depends on length, not on the mass of the bob.
Y has a longer time period, because time period depends on the mass of the bob, not on length.
X and Y have the same time period at every place, because length alone fixes the time period everywhere.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.
